description: Run a package in a temporary environment.

option.name: --aggregate-output
tip: Hold each script's streamed output until the script exits, then print it as one block.

option.name: --allow-build
tip: Package names allowed to run lifecycle (build) scripts during the dlx install.
May be repeated.

option.name: --changed-files-ignore-pattern
tip: Glob patterns of changed files that the [since] --filter selector should ignore.

option.name: --color
tip: Force colored output.

option.name: --cpu
tip: CPU architectures whose platform-tagged optional dependencies the dlx install should keep.
Repeat or comma-separate for multiple.
Every architecture.

next.name: arm64
tip: ARM 64-bit.

next.name: current
tip: This machine's own architecture.

next.name: x64
tip: AMD64 / Intel 64-bit.

option.name: --dir
tip: Set working directory.
Default: .

option.name: --fail-if-no-match
tip: Exit with code 1 when the --filter / --filter-prod selectors match no workspace project.

option.name: --filter
tip: Select which workspace projects to run on.
Repeat to add more.

option.name: --filter-prod
tip: Like --filter, but follow only production dependencies when selecting projects.

option.name: --http-proxy
tip: Proxy for HTTP registry and tarball requests.

option.name: --https-proxy
tip: Proxy for HTTPS registry and tarball requests.

option.name: --ignore-workspace
tip: Run as if the project were standalone, ignoring any pnpm-workspace.yaml above it.

option.name: --include-workspace-root
tip: Also run a recursive command on the root workspace project.

option.name: --libc
tip: libc families (glibc, musl) whose platform-tagged optional dependencies the dlx install should keep.
Repeat or comma-separate for multiple.

next.name: glibc
tip: GNU C Library, used by most Linux distributions.

next.name: musl
tip: Used by Alpine Linux.

option.name: --loglevel
tip: What level of logs to print.

next.name: debug
tip: Debug level logging.

next.name: error
tip: Error level logging.

next.name: info
tip: Info level logging.

next.name: silent
tip: Silent mode: no progress output.

next.name: warn
tip: Warning level logging.

option.name: --no-include-workspace-root
tip: Leave the root workspace project out of a recursive command, overriding an includeWorkspaceRoot: true setting.

option.name: --no-proxy
tip: Hosts that bypass configured proxies.

option.name: --no-sort
tip: Run recursive workspace projects in workspace order.

option.name: --npmrc-auth-file
tip: Path to an .npmrc to read auth settings from, overriding the default ~/.npmrc.

option.name: --os
tip: Operating systems whose platform-tagged optional dependencies the dlx install should keep.
Repeat or comma-separate for multiple.
Every OS.

next.name: current
tip: This machine's own OS.

next.name: darwin
tip: macOS.

next.name: linux
tip: Linux.

next.name: win32
tip: Windows.

option.name: --package
tip: The package to install before running the command.
May be repeated. When omitted, the command name is the package.

option.name: --parallel
tip: Run scripts in every selected workspace project concurrently, disregarding topological sorting.

option.name: --recursive
tip: Run the command for every project in the workspace instead of only the project in --dir.

option.name: --registry
tip: Base URL of the npm registry to resolve and fetch packages from.

option.name: --reporter
tip: Reporter output format.
Default: default.

next.name: append-only
tip: Like default but forces the append-only rendering even on a TTY: one line per update, no cursor movement.

next.name: default
tip: Rich visual output: a progress line, a packages diff, lifecycle output, and a Done in ... summary.

next.name: ndjson
tip: Newline-delimited JSON on stderr.

next.name: silent
tip: No progress output.

option.name: --reverse
tip: Process recursive workspace projects in reverse order.

option.name: --shell-mode
tip: Run the command inside of a shell.
Uses /bin/sh on UNIX and cmd.exe on Windows.

option.name: --silent
tip: Only the output of the executed command is printed.

option.name: --sort
tip: Keep recursive workspace projects sorted topologically.

option.name: --state-dir
tip: Directory in which pnpm persists machine-local state.

option.name: --store-dir
tip: Directory in which the package store is created.
Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root, or from --dir outside a workspace.

option.name: --stream
tip: Stream a recursive command's script output as it arrives, one prefixed line at a time.

option.name: --test-pattern
tip: Glob patterns naming test files, used by the [since] --filter selector to decide which changes count.

option.name: --use-stderr
tip: Divert the reporter's output to stderr, leaving stdout for the command's own result.

option.name: --workspace-concurrency
tip: Maximum number of workspace projects to process in parallel.

option.name: --workspace-packages
tip: Glob patterns selecting the workspace's projects, overriding the packages field of pnpm-workspace.yaml.
Repeat to add more.

option.name: --workspace-root
tip: Run the command on the root workspace project.

option.name: --yes
tip: Automatically answer yes to prompts.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Print help.
